label: GO step after a rewarded trial, agent choosing a1, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2). 100% of mass has prev_reward == 1 and about 94% has the upcoming choice a1 (the agent own upcoming choice, policy logit strongly favoring a1; model_act == 1 gives the same scores, so no future random outcome is involved). It is also strongly gated by time in episode: rate is high for trials 0-29, decays through 30-59 and is zero after about trial 65, so adding ep_trial < 40 lifts precision from 0.33 to 0.78 (dev F1 0.79, mass recall 0.90). Magnitude is largest on the first rewarded a1 choice after an unrewarded trial or an a2 choice, and decays over consecutive rewarded a1 repeats (e.g. 0.97 -> 0.58 -> 0.43, or 0.57 -> 0.24 -> 0.10 -> 0.03); however, explicitly excluding long reward streaks did not improve F1. Does not fire after unrewarded trials, rarely before a2 choices, and not late in the episode. Hidden good state S1 correlates (77% of mass) via choice.
